title: EaseMyTrip Q2: Loss Narrows 98% YoY To ₹57 Lakh, Revenue Up 34%
summary: Online travel aggregator (OTA) EaseMyTrip managed to narrow its consolidated net loss by 98.4% to ₹56.5 Lakh in the second…
llm_summary: EaseMyTrip’s Q2 results show a dramatic turnaround, with its consolidated net loss shrinking by about 98% year‑over‑year to just ₹56.5 lakh, while revenue surged 34% to roughly ₹1.05 billion. The OTA attributes the improvement to stronger bookings, higher average transaction values and tighter cost control, signaling a move toward profitability after a challenging fiscal year.
